scope: Offline revalidation and summaries; no target execution by this analysis. Cache/live are deliberately different workload identities, never pooled together.

derivation.statistics: Median of three independent clean observations; delta = live median minus cache median; liveOverCache = live median / cache median. Sample captures pool only within mode; threshold500, zero-loss and coverage gates.
derivation.timing: Complete child process including source/Base I/O and output; native compiler request only, no QBE machine build.

limitations: Cache/live timing difference is net preparation replacement, not absolute decoder cost.
Three clean repeats provide a range, not a confidence interval; fixed scheduling may retain order effects.
Small profiles with pooled counts below500 retain descriptive fractions only; no quantitative CPU costs.
No dispatch-counter runtime instrumentation was enabled in cache/live runs.
Full-scale physical and context profiles use different intervals and runtime instrumentation; each has one observation, so overhead differences are descriptive, not isolated causal estimates.
The full-scale diagnostic runtime is context-instrumented; counter collection is disabled, so its overhead is not event-counter cost.
